placements.title: Rehearsal converts a claimed capability into a demonstrated one
placements.frame: Does this expression treat an operational capability (a rollback, a recovery, a drill) as real only to the extent it has been actively rehearsed — and does the cadence, formalization, or ownership around it track how that proof is kept current?
placements.why: src-2 states the governing doctrine as a bare aphoristic equivalence ('a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have') — a claim true beyond this document, the narrative-grain test's target. src-1 and src-3 are the same operational fact (monthly Atlas rollback cadence) rendered first as declarative prose and then as a structured field, and src-4 assigns ownership — both are the concrete decision that instantiates the doctrine in src-2, not standalone themes of their own. Together they support one theme: operational capability is proved (or forfeited) through rehearsal, made durable by cadence and named accountability. No existing leaf was available to reuse since the supplied graph structure is empty; this is a NEW node under the newly-minted Organization strata, legible because the content itself supplies both the general principle and its concrete operational instantiation.
